scoringNotes: The Math section is scored on a 200-800 scale; combined with Reading & Writing (200-800) for a total SAT score of 400-1600. Module-adaptive: Module 2 difficulty (easier or harder version) is selected based on Module 1 performance. Scores are equated across test forms so that a given score represents consistent performance regardless of the test date.

specialPolicies.calculatorPolicy: Calculator allowed throughout the entire section. The Desmos graphing calculator is built into the Bluebook app and available for all questions in both modules.
specialPolicies.deliveryNotes: Fully digital exam delivered in the Bluebook app. Module-adaptive: Module 2 difficulty (higher or lower difficulty version) is determined by Module 1 performance. Grid-in (student-produced response) answers are entered as a decimal or fraction in the range 0-9999.
